issuer: the Servicio General de Identificación Personal (SEGIP)
note: Read 2026-10-30 on SEGIP's Licencia para Conducir page. A first licence for adults ('Primera vez para mayores de edad'): minimum age 18 for categories P (particular) and M, 21 for A and T; it needs the identity card, a medical certificate (Bs 50, paid at the clinic, not held), a driving school's certificate of driving skills and the police's traffic and criminal record certificates; the fee for category P is Bs 225, held. Those aged 16 to 18 may get a provisional authorisation, not held. The page doesn't state the licence's term (it says only that a licence not renewed within five years and a day needs a new skills certificate, and that a resident foreigner's licence lasts as long as their foreigner's identity card), so it is null. The identity card is the ids engine's; the exchange agreements weren't read into a list.
